values.note: All campsites $25 per site per night (no hookups); camper cabins $95/night. Refunds less processing fees: full 30+ days out, 50% 15+, 25% 7+, none under 7 days. Read 2026-10-22.

values.note: Online booking (Park With Us) for RV sites, tent sites and cabins; the campground says reservations are needed ('no longer operating under the previous first come, first served cash pay model'), but a walk-in can book an open site in real time over the entry kiosk's open WiFi. Self check-in after 3 pm, check-out 11 am.

If you arrive ... without a reservation please use the open wifi network found at our front entry kiosk ... book it in real-time') + https://parkwith.us/camps/trails-end-campground (booking calendar: Cabin / RV Site / Tent Site), read 2026-10-22

note: Rustic wooded campground around a small lake 1/2 mile west of Copper Harbor on M-26, with camper cabins. Operator: 'most sites accommodate a small pop up camper and some sites accommodate larger RVs' ('several sites that offer a deep, level parking surface to facilitate boondocking with your big rig') - pick a larger site for a 23-ft rig. Spigots are not threaded for a hose: fill tanks before arriving. Not on Lake Superior (bike trail to Hunter's Point). Winter camping allowed, no plowing. --Claude
summary: Operator site confirms $25/site/night (cabins $95), no hookups, potable water at three privies, vault toilets, no showers, no dump station, open year-round, online booking via Park With Us (reserve ahead; walk-ins book in real time at the kiosk).
